title: MyAnimeList Review Crawler
subtitle: From anime reviews to a resumable dataset
description: Collect anime details and reviews through a Jikan-style API or permitted MAL pages, save progress in SQLite and export the dataset as CSV.
longDescription: A Scrapy-based crawler with interchangeable JSON-API and HTML inputs, using the same SQLite tables and CSV output. Sequential requests, retry delays and resume support make long-running collection traceable. The HTML mode follows robots.txt restrictions.
features: SQLite progress storage and resumable runs
CSV output matching the MyAnimeList comment dataset
Sequential requests, backoff and robots.txt handling
